an_clock_back: Warning: the device clock went backwards (restart?) — time alignment may be inaccurate.
an_summary: duration {dur:.0f} s, packets {got} of {exp} (lost {lost}), device clock drift {drift:+.1f} ppm
an_beats: beats found {n}, median heart rate {hr:.0f} bpm
an_motion: motion artefacts in the PPG: {n} ({s:.0f} s, {pct:.1f}% of the session) — heart rate and PPG breathing there are not used
an_beats_poor: WARNING: more than 10% rejected — check the pulse sensor contact; heart-rate results are unreliable.
an_table_head: Marker type           n   SCR found  mean amp., {units}   HR 0.5–3 s / 3–8 s
an_chance: Chance level: a "response" was found in {pct:.0f}% of {n} windows without markers — compare the marker response rate with this.
an_chance_none: Chance level: not enough long gaps without markers.
an_truth_sync: Sync: marker time vs time the "device" received it: mean {mean:+.1f} ms, max |error| {max:.1f} ms (n={n})
an_truth_found: Planted responses found: {tp} of {all};  false responses where none was planted: {fp} of {none}
an_truth_amp: SCR amplitude: mean error {mean:+.3f} µS, spread {sd:.3f} µS
an_truth_lat: Response onset latency: mean error {mean:+.2f} s
an_truth_motion: Motion artefacts: planted {n}, detected {hit}; flagged segments with no planted motion: {false} of {segs}
an_truth_beats: Beats: planted {planted}, found {found}; beat timing spread {sd:.1f} ms (the wave peak lags the beat by ~180 ms by design)
an_breath_ppg: breathing rate from PPG: median {br:.0f} /min ({n} windows of 60 s with a clear rhythm)
an_breath_check: breathing from PPG vs breathing sensor: correlation {r:.2f}, rate {a:.0f} vs {b:.0f} /min
an_title_eda: Skin conductance relative to 2 s before the marker
an_title_hr: Heart rate relative to 3 s before the marker
cal_no_pyserial: The pyserial package is missing. Run the install script again (1_install).
cal_no_port: No serial port found. Connect the board by USB and try again.
cal_port_busy:
Cannot open {port}: {err}
Close the Arduino IDE Serial Monitor (only one program can use the port) and try again.
cal_linux_dialout: On Linux: sudo usermod -a -G dialout $USER, then log out and back in.
cal_connected: Port {port} open. Waiting for the board (it restarts when the port opens)...
cal_no_data: No readings from the board within 12 s. Is the board_check sketch flashed (tools/board_check)?
cal_ads_ok: Board answers; ADS1115 found. Both ADCs will be recorded.
cal_ads_missing: Board answers; ADS1115 NOT found - only the ESP32 ADC will be recorded.
cal_intro:
Take the electrodes off your fingers; the plates must not touch anything.
Connect each resistor to the two plates with clips or hold it by the insulation:
fingers must not touch the metal. Each resistor is recorded for {hold} s by itself.
At any prompt: s = skip this resistor, q = finish now.
cal_start_prompt: Electrodes open and free? Press Enter to start (q = quit):
cal_connect_prompt: Connect {r} and press Enter (or type its measured value in kΩ, then Enter):
cal_bad_number: Not a number. Type the value in kΩ, e.g. 98.6, or just press Enter.
cal_live: {left:4.0f} s left   ESP32 {esp:.0f} mV   ADS1115 {ads} mV
cal_unstable: The reading was unstable: check the clips (and that no finger touches the metal).
cal_repeat_prompt: Press Enter to repeat this resistor, or n to keep it as it is:
cal_disconnect_prompt: Disconnect the resistor (electrodes open) and press Enter:
cal_resets: Warning: the board restarted {n} time(s) during the calibration.
cal_saved:
Saved to: {path}
Zip this folder and send it to Claude.
